title: I Played with Myself COMPETITIVELY (in chess)
summary: 'Played with myself competitively' = chess.com Solo Chess speedrun: capture-only puzzles using only your own pieces. He starts just outside the top 10 (4m 47s 430ms, #11) and tries to break top 10 / top 5 on the leaderboard.
rules: Solo Chess puzzle (chess.com): only your own (white) pieces are on the board, no opponent.
Every move must be a capture of one of your own pieces; normal movement patterns.
Each piece may move (capture) at most twice; after its second capture it turns dark and can't move again.
If a king is on the board it must be the last piece standing (it cannot be captured).
Puzzle is complete when exactly one piece remains.
Levels 1-10 of increasing clutter; speedrun = solve the level sequence as fast as possible (timer starts on first click, stops when the check mark appears).
win_condition: Leave exactly one piece (king last if present) on every level; speedrun time.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream; 'Solo Chess' side panel with level-progress dots; grey dots on capture targets; leaderboard rows

setup: Per-level puzzle positions of only white pieces (procedurally generated levels 1-10).
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'mirror' (bot mirrors your moves) - wrong; this is Solo Chess.
